subject: Pricing proposal: price anchor with soft uplift & sunset clause
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortega <procurement@heliohealth.com>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing proposal: price anchor with soft uplift & sunset clause

Samantha / Evan —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per request, attached is a clean proposal that shows a 3-year price anchor for HelioHealth with a modest annual uplift cap and a sunset clause that prevents aggressive step-ups at renewal. High-level: 

- 3-year initial term; price locked for first 36 months
- Soft uplift cap of 4% YoY on list-equivalent rates after year 1
- Renewal protection: first renewal (year 4) limited to +6% absolute increase, with right to terminate within 30 days if above threshold
- Discount applied: 22% off public list across usage bands (volume tiers in attached exhibit)

This is intended as a middle-ground between HelioHealth’s ask for a full price lock and our need to preserve unit economics as usage scales. Please review the attached and highlight any items you need changed; Jordan is on copy for the technical/contracting side.

Attachments: HelioHealth_Redwood_Proposal_v1.pdf (proposal + pricing exhibit)

Next steps: if the terms look close, can we get a dated signature page and then I’ll route for Deal Desk approval for the discount/terms?

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Ortega <procurement@heliohealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing proposal: price anchor with soft uplift & sunset clause

Camila —

Thanks, reviewed the PDF with finance this morning. HelioHealth can accept a 3-year anchor, provided three specific asks are addressed in the contract: 

1) The uplift cap must be guaranteed at max 4% YoY and apply to total spend (not just per-unit).
2) Renewal protection needs to include a hard cap for the first renewal year: no more than +6% from year 3 to year 4. If the renewal offer exceeds that, HelioHealth may elect a 30-day termination without penalty.
3) A clear sunset clause that prevents any retroactive price re-anchor for new modules bought in year 2 (i.e., new additions should not reset the anchor for prior committed spend).

Also, we need the 22% discount to be fixed for the committed volume tiers in Exhibit A and for Redwood to provide a 30-day notice window for any pricing model changes.

If you can route this for internal executive approval (Helio’s procurement team needs this as a condition of moving to signature), we can target a countersign by 8/18. I’m copying Evan (revenue lead) who will coordinate internal signatures.

Samantha Ortega
Sr. Procurement Manager | HelioHealth
procurement@heliohealth.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing proposal: price anchor with soft uplift & sunset clause

Marissa / Jordan / Laura —

Forwarding HelioHealth’s response; they say yes to a 3-year anchor but are firm on the three conditional items (4% uplift cap, 6% first-renewal cap with 30-day termination option, and a sunset on re-anchoring new modules). They also want the 22% discount fixed for committed tiers and a 30-day notice for pricing model changes.

Quick summary of the commercial ask and why we should consider approval: 
- ACV profile: estimated $720k first-year committed, with expected growth into higher tiers by year 2 — attached modeling shows spend trajectory and unit economics.
- Requested discount: 22% off list (our standard protected discount for an account of this scale is 18–20%); granting 22% would compress blended gross margin by ~4 points in year 1 per the attached modeling.
- Risk: the renewal-protection + sunset clause reduces our ability to reprice new feature-buys into the anchor; legal redline likely needed.

Attachments: deal_summary_helio.csv, modeling_short.xlsx

Request: Exec signoff to accept 3-year anchor with 22% discount subject to the following guardrails: 
1) Maximum approved discount: 22% (no deeper concessions)
2) Require minimum committed usage floor of 18 months (to reduce churn exposure)
3) Legal to accept a narrowly drafted sunset clause limited to modules explicitly listed in Exhibit B (no blanket anti-reprice language)

If you approve, Jordan and I will take the legal redline and produce the final signature-ready packet for countersign. We need a final decision by 08/10 to keep Helio’s 8/18 countersign target.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Camila
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing proposal: price anchor with soft uplift & sunset clause

Camila / Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary and modeling. I’m prepared to approve the following, contingent on the legal and revenue-ops constraints below: 

Approved commercial package (conditional):
- 3-year price anchor with a 22% discount on committed tiers
- Soft uplift cap: 4% YoY applied to total committed spend
- Renewal protection: first renewal increase capped at +6%; Helio may terminate within 30 days in that scenario

Required guardrails before signature:
1) Legal must accept a narrowly scoped sunset clause that lists affected modules (Exhibit B) and explicitly preserves our right to price new, materially different products. No language that broadly prevents re-anchoring for clearly new product categories.
2) Add a minimum 18-month committed usage floor for the anchor to reduce churn risk; include an early-termination repayment schedule if Helio terminates before month 18.
3) Revenue Ops (Laura) to verify margin impacts and cashflow timing; if blended gross margin impact exceeds 6 points vs baseline in any year, return to me for re-review.
4) Approve discount ceiling at 22% — no deeper discounts without my signoff.

Jordan: please coordinate legal redline with a focus on tightening the sunset language and drafting a simple repayment schedule for the 18-month floor. Laura: can you confirm the margin run once legal drafts? If both are green, Marissa approves and we can route for signature.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0112
